Ranks Montgomery census tracts by 2025 code violation counts and joins each tract's adult diabetes prevalence share and population from CDC PLACES data.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261024_72540e'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
),
diabetes AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(diabetes_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS diabetes_share
  FROM session.fw_72540e_m2_cdc
)
SELECT t.name,
       v.code_violations,
       d.diabetes_share,
       d.totalpopulation
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
JOIN diabetes d ON d.geoid = t.geoid
ORDER BY v.code_violations DESC
LIMIT 50
